mentions.h: ROAD RUNNING It's that man again!
MITCHAM AC. YOUNG ATHLETES X-CTY RELAY. February 17th.
mentions.note: the relay cup is named after him
2nd in Billy Morton's Mile 1957; future European 1,500M champion; British champion; in photo of Invitation 800m, White City 1956; 2nd to Moens in Invitation 800m, White City 1956

photos.c: D.Stewart,V.Mugosa (Yugo),R.Moens (Belgium) B. Hewson and J. Davies in the International 800 metres.

The start of the Invitation 800m at the White City, Whitsun 1956. From the inside (right): Hewson the British Champ., John Davies, Sventgali of Hungary the European Champ., Mugosa of Hungary, Roger Moens the Belgian World Record holder, Currie ? cf Oxford, and two others.

Dublin, July 24th 1957 and John Davies leads during "Billy Morton's Mile", followed by Cameron (A.A.A.), Hewson, Delaney (Eire) the Olympic 1,500m champion, and Pirie. A crowd of 28,000 was in attendance.
